items.name: playground-tokens
items.title: Playground tokens
items.description: Playground's tokens and their Tailwind theme: shadcn's semantic colours, the surface ramp with the card and code grounds, status, syntax, type, radius, layout and the phone's safe area, elevation, motion and the product utilities (frosted, gradient-stroke, brand-action, brand-beam, squiggle, fade-edges, edge-torn). Import both files after tailwindcss.

items.name: utils
items.title: cn
items.description: cn, told about the Playground theme's own sizes, weights, shadows, radii, spacing, curves and animations, so text-caption next to a text colour keeps its size. Every Playground component imports cn from here.

items.name: use-indicator
items.title: useIndicator
items.description: Measures the active item in a track, for a thumb that slides to it.

items.name: use-mobile
items.title: useIsMobile
items.description: Stock shadcn hook: true below the mobile breakpoint. The sidebar turns into a sheet there.

items.name: use-scroll-edges
items.title: useScrollEdges
items.description: Which edges of a scroll box have more past them, set as data-more-* for the fade-edges utility.

items.name: use-coarse-pointer
items.title: useCoarsePointer
items.description: Whether the main pointer is a finger, followed live, for behaviour that differs under a finger.

items.name: use-typewriter
items.title: useTypewriter
items.description: Types a text out in about half a second whatever its length, goes on from what is shown when a streamed text grows, and shows it whole with reduced motion.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Stock shadcn button, as the design system ships it, plus the tutorial's soft and quiet variants and action and cta sizes. The stock variants and sizes are unchanged.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: Stock shadcn spinner, as the design system ships it.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Stock shadcn tooltip, as the design system ships it, plus a raised variant (the dark tip, no arrow) and an arrow prop. The default tip is unchanged.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: Stock shadcn separator, as the design system ships it.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: Stock shadcn input, as the design system ships it.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: Stock shadcn textarea, as the design system ships it.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: Stock shadcn label, as the design system ships it.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown menu
items.description: Stock shadcn dropdown menu, as the design system ships it.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Stock shadcn skeleton, as the design system ships it.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: Stock shadcn sheet, as the design system ships it.

items.name: resizable
items.title: Resizable
items.description: Stock shadcn resizable panels, on react-resizable-panels v4.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: Stock shadcn sidebar, as the design system ships it.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: Stock shadcn popover, as the design system ships it. Source peek opens in it.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: Stock shadcn key cap, as the design system ships it. Tool button and Shortcut list show keys with it.

items.name: logo
items.title: Logo
items.description: The Playground mark beside its name. The mark takes the colour of its text.

items.name: status-dot
items.title: Status dot
items.description: The product's one sign for state: idle, success, warning, error, info, running (pulsing) and target.

items.name: brand-button
items.title: Brand button
items.description: The one call to action a screen has: a ring of Solana's two colours that fills on hover, or the flat accent. hover=beam runs a beam of light round the ring instead of filling it.

items.name: async-button
items.title: Async button
items.description: A Button that disables itself and shows a spinner until its onClick promise settles.

items.name: copy-button
items.title: Copy button
items.description: Copies one value. Its tooltip turns from Copy to Copied, and the check on the button says it in green.

items.name: help-tip
items.title: Help tip
items.description: A small question mark with a large place to press, and the answer in a tooltip.

items.name: callout
items.title: Callout
items.description: A tinted note in a page or form: default, info, warning, success, error.

items.name: tag
items.title: Tag
items.description: A tinted label for a kind: level, framework, language. levelVariant() maps a level to its colour.

items.name: stepper
items.title: Stepper
items.description: Write, Build, Deploy, Interact as one switch, with a sliding gradient thumb and a status per stage. Built on Tabs.

items.name: segmented
items.title: Segmented
items.description: One choice of a few, always one: thumb, boxed with a count, gradient, chips. Built on ToggleGroup. From the tutorial: pill, quiet, and a neutral tone for chips.

items.name: composer
items.title: Composer
items.description: The assistant's prompt box: banner, context chips, a growing input, add, model, effort ring, send and stop. collapsible keeps it to one line at rest; suggestion chips fold into More.

items.name: console-drawer
items.title: Console drawer
items.description: A frosted strip under the stage and a well that opens by height, so the terminal stays mounted. ⌘J. Given a height, its top edge drags to resize.

items.name: terminal
items.title: Terminal
items.description: Terminal lines by kind (prompt, output, info, success, warning, error, highlight, link), wrap modes, an empty message, a run's stages and the green block caret.

items.name: code-block
items.title: Code block
items.description: Code with a header, actions that show on hover and line numbers drawn by CSS. Lines take a state (focus, added, landing, error), a token takes the compiler's mark, and long lines can soft wrap.

items.name: diagnostic
items.title: Diagnostic
items.description: A build error said plainly, with the source excerpt and the faulty line marked. DiagnosticMark puts the wavy line under the token.

items.name: diff
items.title: Diff
items.description: A suggested change: added and removed lines, each with its own mark, and the counts. Numbered lines with an edge, struck removals, notes pinned to lines and gaps between runs.

items.name: action-card
items.title: Action card
items.description: A card you open, with a link stretched over it. default, or frame with the brand ring and lift. fill is the tutorial gallery's card, with a meta line and a corner indicator.

items.name: setup-list
items.title: Setup list
items.description: The sidebar's Get set up checklist: count in the title, fold, dismiss, and a status per step.

items.name: step-rail
items.title: Step rail
items.description: A lesson's steps as a vertical line: done, skipped, current, locked.

items.name: objective-band
items.title: Objective band
items.description: A lesson's frosted band: a gradient meter, the objective, back and on, and actions.

items.name: stage-empty
items.title: Stage empty
items.description: What a stage says before it has anything: media, title, meta, description, notice, actions, footer.

items.name: modal
items.title: Modal
items.description: The product's dialog: a card on a desk, a page of its own on a phone, and a wide size.

items.name: menu-extras
items.title: Menu extras
items.description: Parts for shadcn's menus: a line under an item, a note, and rows that fold open in place.

items.name: editor-tabs
items.title: Editor tabs
items.description: The open files over the editor, the current one marked with a purple top line. quiet sets it on the code ground with no line; edges fade, the current tab follows, and a bar holds tools at the end.

items.name: drop-zone
items.title: Drop zone
items.description: Where a file lands, and a button to browse for one.

items.name: achievement
items.title: Achievement
items.description: An achievement for a profile: a gradient ring when earned, grey until then. appear pops it in once with a glow.

items.name: merge
items.title: Merge
items.description: Two devices' changes to the same lines, after IDEA's merge dialog: this device, the result and the other device, joined by ribbons, with take and dismiss on each hunk and one pane at a time at phone width. It draws; the editors in the panes are the app's.

items.name: quiz
items.title: Quiz
items.description: A question with a few options, ringed in the gradient while it waits: right lights green, wrong turns red with a reason and shakes, keys pick, and it folds to a one line record that opens to the options as they ended.

items.name: run-card
items.title: Run card
items.description: Something to run from the conversation: icon, title, context that becomes the stage, a button that keeps its width under a spinner, a timed bar along the foot, and the one line record it folds to.

items.name: result-card
items.title: Result card
items.description: A finished run: a status row (title 16/24 and meta 14/18 on one baseline), the result, and details that open in the same box from the head's chevron. default or error, and lg for a failure still waiting on you. Pair it with ResultDetails for what happened in plain words.

items.name: result-details
items.title: Result details
items.description: A result's details in plain words: one sentence with its key in a code chip, one row of quiet controls (copy the key, open it in Explorer, the log's toggle), and the raw log in a dark well with the way to the terminal.

items.name: milestone
items.title: Milestone
items.description: A step passed: a check that draws itself, a display headline, one line and the way on, and the one line record with the time it folds to.

items.name: step-heading
items.title: Step heading
items.description: Where a step starts in a conversation: its goal as a heading at 24/28, lit once when jumped to.

items.name: lesson-intro
items.title: Lesson intro
items.description: A lesson's first message: thumb, title and facts, the promise, the proof line, how it goes, a note and Start. card or plain.

items.name: check-list
items.title: Check list
items.description: What a lesson taught: a green tick a line at the reading weight.

items.name: prose
items.title: Prose
items.description: One line of lesson text with code in backticks as InlineCode chips and links, safe while it is still typing out. InlineCode on its own for code in a sentence.

items.name: key-row
items.title: Key row
items.description: A key a run leaves behind in one line: its label, the key cut six and six, Copy and the Explorer link. On a narrow card the label goes over the key. Exports shortKey.

items.name: receipt
items.title: Receipt
items.description: What a transaction leaves behind: a printed slip with dashed rules and a torn foot, quiet lines of signature and fee, or the answer at size with a foot that opens the slip. Lines can print in one by one.

items.name: code-quote
items.title: Code quote
items.description: One line of a file quoted in a message: path and line, a way back to it, the line itself; red with a wavy mark under the token the compiler named.

items.name: file-change
items.title: File change
items.description: A file the assistant touched: written (its name and first lines, which scroll sideways instead of wrapping; the card opens the file), created (one row with a New file tag) or a proposal (a numbered diff with Apply and Keep it), and the record a proposal folds to.

items.name: source-peek
items.title: Source peek
items.description: A caption under a log line that opens a read only peek of the file around the line it came from: on hover with a mouse, pinned by a click, on tap under a finger.

items.name: step-track
items.title: Step track
items.description: A lesson's steps across the top: one line saying where you are that opens the steps in a menu, and under it 4px segments with one purple to green fill across them, reached segments a way back. StepTrackBar is the bare track for a phone's header.

items.name: file-tree
items.title: File tree
items.description: A project's files by folder: 28px rows (44 on touch), the open file filled, a dot on the step's file, a file not there yet disabled with a note, arrow keys. FileTreeDock docks it beside the editor.

items.name: call-form
items.title: Call form
items.description: A program's instructions as a form drawn from its IDL: instruction chips, the signature, typed args and accounts, Call, the response (status, the program's words, the account, then a quiet sentence with Copy, Explorer and Log), and Form | IDL with the JSON and Copy. Takes the IDL and onCall.

items.name: meter
items.title: Meter
items.description: A value against its most: cells (energy, an account in blocks) or a bar with a threshold tick that turns red past it. role=meter.

items.name: tool-button
items.title: Tool button
items.description: A tool at a bar's end: the glyph alone in a ghost square, lit while its panel is open, the name and key in a raised tip.

items.name: filter-button
items.title: Filter button
items.description: An icon beside a search that opens one choice under a quiet heading, with a dot while a filter is on. boxed for a desk, bare for a phone.

items.name: search-field
items.title: Search field
items.description: A search in a soft well. Esc clears, then closes. collapsible folds it to a square under 35rem of its row and opens it across the row with Cancel.

items.name: coach-mark
items.title: Coach mark
items.description: A one time hint beside what it is about, in the raised tip's look, gone after a few seconds or the first input. useCoachMark shows it once, kept in storage.

items.name: shortcut-list
items.title: Shortcut list
items.description: Every shortcut as a row of what it does and its keys, in named groups with no rules between rows. Put it in a Modal.

items.name: brand-icon
items.title: Brand icon
items.description: The product's icons cut from the mark's shapes: home, new, tutorial, programs, search and profile, each at its own aspect. Also exports the mark's path they are cut from (client-v2's newer mark, not LogoMark).

items.name: phone-bar
items.title: Phone bar
items.description: A phone screen's head: a 44px slot either side, the title after a back button or on the content's own edge.

items.name: phone-nav
items.title: Phone nav
items.description: The product's navigation on a phone: a full screen layer opened from the menu button, its X on the same spot, destinations, a labelled group and a foot row over the home indicator.

items.name: feature-banner
items.title: Feature banner
items.description: The banner at the top of a gallery: state line, title, one line, progress or facts, the brand action and a quiet one, with art behind the words that moves to the corner under 640px. Ships the Bayer dither and the code picture as parts.

items.name: iso-voxels
items.title: Iso voxels
items.description: The mark as an isometric voxel sculpture on a canvas, shaded from the brand tokens: tiles rise in, a ripple runs through, the pointer bumps them. Draws an SVG still of its rest for snapshots.

items.name: lit-ground
items.title: Lit ground
items.description: The brand grid under a page, rising from the foot, a little brighter through a soft circle that trails the pointer.

items.name: tutorial-cover
items.title: Tutorial cover
items.description: A generated cover: one of four brand grounds by framework, and the mark placed by a hash of the name, so a name always gives the same cover.

items.name: thumb
items.title: Thumb
items.description: One frame for covers of any shape: square art fills, anything else fits whole on its own edge colour, with a hairline over the picture.

items.name: playground
items.title: Everything
items.description: The tokens and every Playground component, in one install.
